A''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]''' was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a chief [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] aboard the modified [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']].

==History==
During the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] campaign against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], the chief pilot was assigned to the recently captured [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']], a modified [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] that [[Wraith Squadron]] managed to capture from Zsinj's fleet. His assignment was due to the loss of the ship's entire bridge crew&mdash;with the exception of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Atril Tabanne]]&mdash;during the [[Battle of Talasea]]. The chief pilot would later survive the [[Battle of Ession|battle]] between the New Republic and Zsinj's vassal [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Apwar Trigit]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ession]].<ref name="WS" />
